text:
jordan_sales: Heads up — ACME POC is hitting a lot of 429s on /v1/embeddings during their batch import. They said errors spike after ~3k items. Need triage and (maybe) temporary quota uplift.

mika_se: Got it. Can you paste a sample request + response headers and the approximate timestamps?

jordan_sales: Sample from customer at 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \u002dH "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \u002dH "Content-Type: application/json" \u002d-d '{"model":"embed-large","inputs":[...batch of 64...]}'
```
Response headers (429):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:12:03 GMT
X-RateLimit-Limit: 40
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 60
Content-Type: application/json
```

quota-bot: [alert] tenant=acme-poc route=/v1/embeddings event=burst_exceeded window=60s count=320

ryan_engineering: Runtime logs match — we see "burst limit exceeded" + token budget exhaustion traces. Current tenant config shows per-route: rate=40 rps, burst=80, token_budget=50000 per 60s. They were sending many concurrent small batches which drains token budget quickly.

anya_prod: Is this a hosted account? If yes, default burst window is 60s. We can do a temporary uplift (24h) for the POC, but sustained uplift requires a reserved capacity discussion.

mika_se: Short-term mitigations for customer: 1) reduce client parallelism (concurrency_limit=8) 2) batch up to 64 per req instead of many small requests 3) implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After. Also enable prefix caching for duplicate IDs.

devops_oncall: I can apply a quick per-route override for acme-poc: propose rate=100, burst=200, token_budget=120000 TTL=12h. Will push change and share command.

jordan_sales: Thanks. Also customer wants a quick cost estimate if they sustain ~100k extra tokens/hr during POC — need rough numbers to share.

anya_prod: Rough ballpark: our hosted token pricing ~ $0.0025 per 1k tokens. 100k tokens/hr ~= 100 * $0.0025 = $0.25/hr -> ~$180/mo if constant 24/7. I'll follow up with formal quote tomorrow.

devops_oncall: Override applied. Command used:
```
redwoodctl quotas set --tenant acme-poc --route /v1/embeddings --rate 100 --burst 200 --token-budget 120000 --ttl 43200
```
No runtime restart required. Changes active in ~10s.

mika_se: Customer re-ran the import. Initial checks: retries dropped a lot but a few 429s remain at burst peaks. Recommend client-side backoff + honoring Retry-After header.

jordan_sales: :thumbsup: I'll tell them to run full import and report. Also asking for logs to confirm behaviour.

quota-bot: metric snapshot: pre-override 429_rate=18% (10m window) -> post-override 429_rate=3% (10m). Saved logs: /internal/logs/1767845123-embeds-raw.log

ryan_engineering: Follow-up action: add a short doc in /docs/serving/rate-limits.md explaining token_budget vs request_rate and common client mitigations. I'll open a PR.

mika_se: Thanks everyone — please add any cost/commit guidance if customer asks to scale permanently.
